name: train
description: Run one synchronized Bullet training rank on every selected GPU host

nnue_repo.help: Committed NNUE trainer, configuration, and build files staged identically on every host

run.help: Training run name; must match build.json's run field

shard_dir.help: Directory containing one HOST.bullet file for every selected worker

parent_checkpoint.help: Parent NNUE checkpoint; staged identically and injected as initialize_from

coordinator.help: Selected host that runs the coordinator rank

sync_every.help: Distributed optimizer synchronization interval in superbatches

sources.name: nnue trainer
build: CUDA_PATH="${CUDA_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$CUDA_PATH" ]; then for candidate in /usr/local/cuda /usr/lib/cuda; do if [ -f "$candidate/include/cuda.h" ]; then CUDA_PATH="$candidate"; break; fi; done; fi; test -n "$CUDA_PATH" && test -f "$CUDA_PATH/include/cuda.h"; export CUDA_PATH CUDA_HOME="${CUDA_HOME:-$CUDA_PATH}"; export PATH="$CUDA_PATH/bin:$PATH"; cargo build --release --features cuda --manifest-path tools/bullet/spike_trainer/Cargo.toml

task.command:
set -euo pipefail; HOST="$(hostname -s)"; if [ "$HOST" = "{coordinator}" ]; then ROLE=coordinator; ROLE_ARGS=(ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:{listen_port} ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_NUM_PEERS={peer_count}); else ROLE=worker; ROLE_ARGS=(ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_COORDINATOR_ADDR={coordinator}:{listen_port}); fi; BUILD=".forge-{task_name}.build.json"; python3 - build.json "$BUILD" ~/.cache/forge/inputs/train/{run}/parent.nn <<'PY'
import json
import sys
source, destination, parent = sys.argv[1:]
with open(source, encoding='utf-8') as handle:
    build = json.load(handle)
build['initialize_from'] = parent
with open(destination, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
    json.dump(build, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    handle.write('\n')
PY
env ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_ROLE="$ROLE" ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_RUN_ID="{run_name}" ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_NODE_ID="$HOST" ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_DATA="{train_shard}" ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_SYNC_EVERY={sync_every} ENYO_BULLET_DISTRIBUTED_TIMEOUT_SECS={timeout_seconds} "${{{{ROLE_ARGS[@]}}}}" tools/bullet/spike_trainer/target/release/train run --build "$BUILD"; QUANTISED="$(find "runs/{run}/checkpoints" -type f -name quantised.bin -print | sort | tail -n 1)"; test -n "$QUANTISED"; python3 - "$QUANTISED" "{output_dir}/{task_name}.quantised.sha256" <<'PY'
import hashlib
import pathlib
import sys
source, output = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
hash = hashlib.sha256()
with source.open('rb') as handle:
    for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
        hash.update(chunk)
pathlib.Path(output).write_text(hash.hexdigest() + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
PY
